description:
Fetch a single website by id, including its status, scan counts, and public id.

Args:
  - id (string): The site id.

Returns JSON: a Site object. scriptsFound is null (not measured in the stored website snapshot). pending means awaiting a completed scan; scanning means in progress; compliant means the scan completed successfully, not legal compliance; attention means scan failure or review needed. Returns a not_found error if the site does not exist or your key cannot access it. Requires scope: sites:read.
name: consentease_get_site
title: Get a ConsentEase site
